author: Basder
quote: 13 years just to get a SIMS game with great graphics. The game is overpriced, 30fps or lower, boring, overrated, boring story. The gameplay is fine but you get bored fast. Just play GTA V and avoid the chores.

quote: This game exceeded my expectations. The graphics and detail are impecable and the story is very epic and gives you a clean presentation of Chinese mythology while respecting the culture at the same time.
